title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: orthogonalDrawing
text:
orthogonal drawing
orthogonal drawing
(definition)
Definition:
A
graph drawing
in which each edge is represented by a polyline, each segment of which is parallel to a coordinate axis.
See also
grid drawing
,
straight-line drawing
.
